009497  PROCEDURE DIVISION USING W77-SISTEMA-PARAMETRO.                 151900      
009498  DECLARATIVES.                                                   152000      
009499  HI-INTERRUPT SECTION.                                           152005      
009500       USE AS INTERRUPT PROCEDURE.                                152007      
009501  INTERRUP-BY-HI.                                                 152009      
009502       DISALLOW INTERRUPT.                                        152011      
009503       MOVE ATTRIBUTE TASKVALUE OF MYSELF TO W77-INTERRUP.        152013      
009504       IF W88-HI11                                                152015      
009505          CANCEL "S500L020"                                       152017      
009506          MOVE "I"                TO TIPO-LJ                      152021      
009507          MOVE 020201             TO CODIGO-LJ                    152023      
009508          MOVE "S500L020SDOS"     TO WKS-CTLVERS-LIBRERIA         152035      
009509          MOVE ZERO               TO WKS-CTLVERS-STATUS           152037      
009510          CALL "DAME_TIT IN CTRLVERS"                             152039      
009511               USING  WKS-CTLVERS-LIBRERIA                        152041      
009512                      WKS-CTLVERS-TITULO                          152043      
009513               GIVING WKS-CTLVERS-STATUS                          152045      
009514                                                                  152047      
009515          IF WKS-CTLVERS-STATUS < 0                               152049      
009516             MOVE "ERROR AL OBTENER NOMBRE S500L020SDOS"          152051      
009517                                  TO TEXTO-LJ                     152053      
009518             MOVE "I"             TO TIPO-LJ                      152055      
009519             MOVE 020901          TO CODIGO-LJ                    152057      
009520             CALL "LJ IN LIB-DISP" USING CONTADOR-LJ, MENSAJE-LJ  152059
